text:
Jenna Park: Quick check-in for EdgeBox + InfraSys marketplace launch. Main goals: marketplace listing + partner co-sell page, SI integration note, and coordinated press window. Target publish: 2025-08-04 15:00 UTC. Can we confirm owners and blockers?

Omar Ruiz: I’ll own the listing mapping to SKU: RBW-EDGE-001 and the marketplace enablement doc. Need final InfraSys integration guide (6 steps) and an architecture diagram (SVG).

Nisha Patel: Marketing will own the co-sell page and the press kit. I need partner-approved logos (SVG), 2 quotes (EdgeBox & InfraSys), and a hero screenshot of the console flow. Deadline Tue EOD.

Kelsey Wright: Engineering note: the EdgeBox package has a hardware split path (on-prem appliance) and a cloud-managed route. We must surface both SKUs and call out latency tiers. QA matrix for both paths is uploaded to the staging repo.

Diego Alvarez: Integrations: InfraSys will provide an OIDC client and a Terraform module. We need sample infra templates + CI example. Diego -> will collate infra artifacts.

legal-bot: Reminder: partner MSA clause 4.2 requires explicit consent for co-branded announcements. Legal needs partner-signed addendum before publish. Jenna, please confirm partner signature ETA.

Jenna Park: I emailed EdgeBox legal and InfraSys legal. EdgeBox replied: sign by 2025-08-01 COB. InfraSys asked for our embargo language; awaiting reply.

Omar Ruiz: Technical checklist snapshot: 1) SKU mapping done, 2) listing metadata (tags, pricing tier, trial flag), 3) redirect slug ready, 4) telemetry keys validated. I pushed a draft JSON to repo: https://git.redwood.ai/marketplace/edgebox/sku.json

Nisha Patel: Press plan: embargo at T-30m for partner PR teams, T-10m internal all-hands, T+0 publish, T+15m social push. Need partner contact person for press coordination. Also request a joint blog outline (we'll draft then send to partners).

Kelsey Wright: Deploy plan for listing: staging -> canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% over 25 minutes. Smoke tests include: generate latency (50p), bulk-embed sanity, and marketplace checkout flow. Failure thresholds set in runbook.

Diego Alvarez: Infra pieces: posting Terraform examples into the marketplace repo, adding a test harness against EdgeBox appliance (serial number emulator). ETA tomorrow afternoon.

Jenna Park: Partner press contacts: EdgeBox PR is pr@edgebox.ai (Samantha Lee). InfraSys PR is media@infrasys.co (Tom Rivers). Laura in legal will coordinate embargo text with them.

legal-bot: Action: attach signed addendum PDF to the listing page before publish. If not attached, publish job will fail preflight.

Nisha Patel: GA tracking: add utm_campaign=edgebox_marketplace and campaign_id=rbw_edge_aug. Analytics to be verified in staging. Also please ensure the partner referral tag parameter is present.

Omar Ruiz: Listing slug: /marketplace/edgebox-infrasys. I created a staging preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/marketplace/edgebox-infrasys-preview

Kelsey Wright: Ops: I'll schedule deploy window for 2025-08-04T15:00Z - 15:30Z. Will run smoke tests and hold the rollback tag: rollback-edgebox-2301234567. Ops oncall: @ops-team.

Diego Alvarez: CI note: add terraform apply job to the marketplace CI for the infra examples. Also will add an e2e that spins up the OIDC flow against a mock InfraSys endpoint.

Jenna Park: Marketing assets checklist posted to doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketplace/assets/edgebox-infrasys. Please mark your items done in comments.

Nisha Patel: Draft blog headline: "EdgeBox + Redwood Inference: Low-latency inference at the edge (with InfraSys managed integration)". I'll drop the draft in the doc for partner review.

Omar Ruiz: Partner quote placeholders sent to partners. EdgeBox asked to tweak the wording on latency numbers. Hold until their comms team returns numbers.

legal-bot: Update: EdgeBox signed addendum received 2025-08-01T18:02Z. InfraSys signoff pending.

Diego Alvarez: InfraSys provided Terraform module v1.2. I pushed tests and example. CI green locally.

Kelsey Wright: Canary dashboard set up: https://ops.redwood.ai/dashboards/edgebox-canary. Will monitor errors, tail-latency, and token-usage per-session.

Nisha Patel: Partner logos received (EdgeBox + InfraSys) and uploaded to staging assets. Waiting for partner quote final texts.

Jenna Park: Action recap: Omar (SKU, staging listing), Nisha (press/blog/assets), Kelsey (deploy/canary/smoke), Diego (infra examples + CI), Laura/legal (addendum + embargo). Please confirm done in thread when complete.

Omar Ruiz: Confirmed. SKU and staging listing ready.

Diego Alvarez: Confirmed. Infra examples merged.

Kelsey Wright: Confirmed. Deploy window reserved and smoke tests ready.

Nisha Patel: Confirmed once partner quotes are in; uploaded assets present.

legal-bot: InfraSys addendum received 2025-08-03T09:11Z. All legal attachments present.

publish-bot: Preflight run OK. Embargo schedule set for 2025-08-04T14:30Z (T-30m notify partners) and publish at 2025-08-04T15:00Z. Manual approval required at deploy step.

Jenna Park: Great work team. Final reminder: post partner-signed blog and final asset links here before T-30m so marketing can attach them to the listing.

Omar Ruiz: Will post final links after manual verification.

Nisha Patel: Will post final blog draft + social copy here by 2025-08-04T14:00Z.

Kelsey Wright: Standing by for manual approval during the window.

publish-bot: Publish scheduled and waiting for manual approval.

Jenna Park: Closing thread 1 :rocket:
